title: Supported optimizer runtime integrations
description:
# Supported optimizer runtime integrations

## Purpose

Integrate Plexus optimization workflows through stable, supported Tactus lifecycle, model, telemetry, storage, authentication, and artifact-transfer interfaces. The current program removes the need for AWS CLI credentials from local evaluation and optimization while preserving explicit IAM authentication for deployed workloads.

## Exclusions

- Runtime monkeypatching or private Tactus method replacement.
- AWS SSO, public API-key, inline-data, direct-S3, or silent storage fallbacks for the migrated local workflow.
- Remote task execution.
- Unrelated reporting and deployment utilities that legitimately run under workload IAM.
- Client-specific data or incidents.

## Official interfaces

- plexus login
- plexus whoami
- plexus logout
- Explicit Cognito and IAM modes in PlexusDashboardClient
- createArtifactTransferTickets
- GraphQLArtifactStore

## Architecture and rollout

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    C["plx-0c9d2e Freeze contracts"]
    A["plx-0431ae Cognito CLI and client"]
    B["plx-8b44b9 Artifact ticket backend"]
    S["plx-18708d GraphQLArtifactStore"]
    P["plx-52c1bd Procedure persistence"]
    E["plx-5dc035 Evaluation artifacts"]
    O["plx-dbe0cf Optimizer and task artifacts"]
    I["plx-9b1f3d Integration and rollout"]

    C --> A
    C --> B
    C --> S
    A --> P
    B --> P
    S --> P
    A --> E
    B --> E
    S --> E
    A --> O
    B --> O
    S --> O
    P --> I
    E --> I
    O --> I
```

Wave 1 builds additive application authentication, transfer authorization, and the shared artifact client in parallel. The additive backend deploys before Wave 2 migrates storage consumers. Wave 2 migrates three independent artifact families in parallel. Final integration proves the complete workflow without local AWS credentials.

## Behavior stories

- [ ] plx-a9471c CLI users authenticate without AWS credentials
- [ ] plx-c4ca2e Artifact transfers use application authorization
- [ ] plx-b75a39 Local evaluations and optimizations run without AWS credentials

## Implementation and acceptance tasks

- [ ] plx-0c9d2e Freeze authentication and artifact-transfer contracts
- [ ] plx-0431ae Implement Cognito CLI authentication and dashboard client support
- [ ] plx-8b44b9 Implement authenticated GraphQL artifact-transfer tickets
- [ ] plx-18708d Implement GraphQLArtifactStore
- [ ] plx-52c1bd Migrate procedure and Tactus persistence
- [ ] plx-5dc035 Migrate evaluation datasets, evidence, logs, and traces
- [ ] plx-dbe0cf Migrate optimizer and task artifacts
- [ ] plx-9b1f3d Run credential-free integration acceptance and rollout

## Dependencies

Released public Tactus lifecycle and storage interfaces remain the supported integration boundary. Each task records its own worktree, branch, base commit, agent owner, focused tests, evidence, and handoff. Explicit Kanbus blocked-by relations are authoritative for dispatch readiness.

## Definition of Done

- The three behavior stories pass their executable specifications.
- Local evaluation and optimization run after one Plexus application login with all AWS profile and session variables removed.
- Authentication refresh, artifact authorization, integrity validation, resume, and dashboard visibility are proven.
- Python 3.11 and 3.12 CI plus dashboard typecheck, unit, Storybook, and browser tests pass.
- Additive backend support is deployed before migrated clients.
- No private runtime replacement, direct-S3 fallback, API-key fallback, AWS-SSO fallback, or silent storage fallback remains in the migrated path.
- Final rollout evidence is recorded before this epic closes.

## Running log

Record sanitized decisions, attempts, outcomes, dependency changes, test evidence, PRs, and next steps in this epic or its child tasks. Every coding-agent kickoff must name its canonical agent task, isolated worktree, branch, base commit, owned scope, and dependency boundary.
